items.t: Passenger airbag inflator can rupture (recall)
Driver airbag inflator can rupture (recall)
Older driver airbag inflator can rupture (recall)
items.job: Inspect and replace driver airbag inflator (recall)

items.t: Front lower ball joints can wear and separate (recall)
items.note: If the recall was done long ago and the joints are worn again, expect a paid repair of about 1.5-2.5 hours per side; ask for a written quote.

items.t: Transmission case bolt can loosen and lose Park (recall)
Harsh or delayed shift from 1st to 2nd gear
items.note: If internal parts are worn, a used or rebuilt transmission runs $1,500-3,500 in parts plus 6-9 hours.

items.t: Engine starts then dies when the key is released
A/C stops cooling or the compressor fails
items.job: Replace A/C compressor, receiver-dryer and recharge
items.note: CarComplaints owners report about $2,000-2,700 for major A/C failures.

items.t: SRS airbag warning light stays on
items.job: Diagnose SRS codes and replace faulty sensor

items.t: Check engine light from an EVAP leak code
items.job: Replace gas cap or EVAP bypass solenoid

items.t: Cranks but won't start with the immobilizer light flashing
items.job: Replace and program a new key (or diagnose immobilizer)

items.t: Brake lights may not work from a contaminated switch (recall)
items.job: Clean pedal area and replace brake light switch (recall)

items.t: Corroded brake master cylinder reduces braking (recall)
items.job: Replace brake master cylinder, reservoir and fluid (recall)

items.t: Power steering hose can crack and leak (recall)
Stability control can brake on its own (recall)
items.job: Install VSA wiring harness and tighten ground (recall)

items.t: Fuel pump relay can fail and stall the engine (recall)
Brake master cylinder seal can leak (recall)
Doors won't lock or unlock from the handle sensor
items.job: Replace outer door handle with touch sensor
items.note: An owner on AcuraZine reports about $200 per door at a dealer.

items.t: Engine shudder or no shift into 4th gear
Torque converter judder while cruising
items.job: Update transmission software and replace torque converter if needed
items.note: Acura extended the warranty on the torque converter; check coverage with a dealer first.

items.t: Navigation clock or date shows the wrong time
items.job: Navigation software update or GPS unit service

items.t: Fuel pump can fail and stall the engine (recall)
Early RLX fuel pump can fail (recall)
Timing belt teeth can separate (recall)
items.job: Replace timing belt and inspect engine (recall)

items.t: Collision braking may brake for guardrails (recall)
Headlight reflector can peel and dim the lights (recall)
Front seat belts may not extend or retract in cold weather (recall)
Moaning or rubbing noise from the rear while steering
items.note: Covered by an Acura warranty extension; out-of-coverage repairs vary widely.

items.t: Torque converter shudder at 20-60 mph
items.job: Transmission software update and fluid replacement
items.note: Replacing the torque converter, if still needed, adds about $400-900 in parts and 6-8 hours.

items.t: Rough running at cruise with a flashing check engine light
items.job: Diagnose misfire and update engine software

items.t: Chirp from the timing belt area after warm-up
items.job: Inspect and service timing belt area per bulletin

items.t: Check engine light for misfire or lean codes
Flashing D indicator and rough shifting
Tires slowly lose air
items.job: Replace valve stems and reseal tire beads

items.t: Rear lower control arm bolts can loosen (recall)
items.job: Replace rear lower control arm bolts (recall)
